abilities.name: One-Two
abilities.condition: Pass then use again to return. Final receiver gets 10–15% shot buff for 10s

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: Raichi release
history.text: Raichi added; mobile Fast Mode, private-server ability hitbox display and mobile/console PS+ commands menu introduced.

history.title: Kurona rework
history.text: One-Two gained a return-pass interaction and 10–15% shot buff for the final receiver for 10s; Shark-Steal improved and Bait Dribble added.

history.title: Great rebalancing
history.text: Ball Trajectory Metavision for all goalkeepers, Loki and Nagi. Loki base/passive overhaul; extensive style cooldown and range changes, removals and vaulting.

history.title: Kurona patch
history.text: Revised Kurona update addressing issues with the original rollout.
